title: Artifact Inflation Without Epistemic Grounding v0.1.3: A Claim-Bounded Case Study of Non-Expert AI-Assisted Research
description: A claim-bounded public repository refresh of a reflexive case study on artifact inflation, epistemic grounding failure, and claim-boundary control in non-expert AI-assisted research. It preserves the v0.1.2 ai.vixra-oriented manuscript and adds public landing pages, metadata drafts, claim-boundary orientation, and regenerated manifests. It does not claim a battery technology, BMS method, cosmological solution, observational likelihood, MCMC posterior, evidence comparison, or a statistical conclusion about all AI-assisted research.
notes: License terms are defined in the repository license files. This repository is an evaluation-oriented archive and does not present validated battery-engineering or cosmological results.
